trigger: Fixed training101_479 mean u relativeL2 .2140335 versus recovered corner-P1 symmetric tensor relativeL2 9.409880. Current predicted strain is unreliable; stress-conditioning trial did not improve overall validation.
hypothesis: A matched training-u-derived P1 gradient objective can reduce local derivative error while retaining displacement accuracy across validation CADs.
model: Existing load-linear PhysicsField, original25+actual local13, global PointNet32, decoder128x2, nine response outputs; no architecture change or GT response input.
scope: Locked40 trainCAD x ver/hor/tor and5 validationCAD x ver/hor/tor. No dia or final5 fields. Original signed uXYZ and physical mm geometry.

matched_common_sampling.u_objective_points: all12800 queries percase, identical mixed uniform/corner distribution in both branches
matched_common_sampling.comparison_boundary: Common sampler differs from the historical all-uniform-node teacher. Only this new matched pair isolates the auxiliary gradient objective.

objective.u: Existing train-case-relative MSE with unchanged train-only common zero-center displacement RMS decoder.
objective.numerics: FP64 physical geometry and differentiable corner solve; ordinary first-order parameter gradients, no TCNN coordinate second derivatives.
objective.targets: Reference corner-P1 derived from training u labels. Extra derivative supervision is disclosed; it is not a recovered solver strain/stress tensor.
objective.normalization_fit: train120 cases only; validation reference tensors used only to report diagnostics, never fit scales or weights.

checkpoint_selection: Minimum known-load validation case-mean physical u relativeL2 ONLY; gradient diagnostic does not select steps.
metrics: At each same selected checkpoint, report physical all-node u mean/worst/max and existing all10-node volume-averaged corner-P1 symmetric-Frobenius mean/worst. Also fixedTRAIN101_479 by load; no new constitutive scalar stress target.

predeclared_next_gate.criterion: At u-selected checkpoints, actualgradient must reduce validation mean P1 error by >=30% relative to matchedzero, fixedTRAIN101_479 mean P1 error by >=50%, and increase validation u mean and worst by <=2 percentage points each.
predeclared_next_gate.if_pass: Repeat the same pair at seed2027 before spending another stress-training pair.
predeclared_next_gate.if_fail: Use the matched loss/physical metrics to diagnose whether derivative optimization fails or CAD transfer remains the bottleneck; choose one smallest next control. No automatic loss/width sweep.

parallel_input_only_diagnostic: BC-role coverage passed all45 original1024-point clouds (support15-43,load7-21). This remains an unimplemented alternative; it is not mixed into the gradient pair.
